# Osama Tahir

> Dubai-based Senior Mobile & Full-Stack Developer building mobile apps, websites, backend systems, business platforms and payment integrations for UAE and GCC businesses.

Osama Tahir is a senior mobile and full-stack developer based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. He builds Flutter and React Native iOS/Android apps, production websites and web platforms, Laravel and Node.js APIs, payment integrations (Stripe, Apple Pay, Network International, RevenueCat), CRMs and operational platforms. Typical engagements cover architecture, implementation, App Store / Google Play launch, website launch, and production support — including takeover of unfinished apps and white-label delivery for agencies.
